lines.text: God sent the angel Gabriel to a virgin named Mary in Nazareth, a town in Galilee.
Mary was greatly troubled at the angel's greeting, so he told her not to be afraid.
Gabriel said Mary would bear a son named Jesus, who would receive the throne of His father Abraham.
Mary asked how this could be, and Gabriel said the Holy Spirit would come upon her.
Gabriel said Rachel, her relative, was in her sixth month, and Mary answered that she was the Lord's servant.
